name: Hardkore Parkore | Prototype v1.13 [PC w/ Controller Support]
author: SimplySamu3L
description:
Hardkore Parkore (Prototype Version 1.13 - PC) | [NOTE: An External Wireless or Wired Mouse is Highly Recommended for the Best Experience while Playing | 🎮Wired or Wireless Controllers are also Compatible (Move=LeftJoystick, Look=RightJoystick, Jump=x-button or a-button, Sprint=LeftTrigger)🎮] - There WILL be Updates for this game semi-frequently. | A New Update is OUT! {🗣️📢Version 1.13 - This Update Includes: Mobile Support [MOBILE DOES NOT WORK YET: I'm Working on a Fix. Please hang Tight!] |  Version 1.12 - This Update includes Environment changes, Atmospheric changes and Background Music} Stay Tuned For More Updates to Come! | {📌INSTRUCTIONS/ABOUT}:
About/How to Play?: The goal of the game is for the player (You) to reach the End platform raised above the ground by utilizing the sprint (Shift Key), jump (Spacebar), and movement controls (W, A, S, D or the Up, Left, Down, and Right Arrow keys) in order to jump across platform to platform until finally reaching the End point. Since this is a short Experience and the length of the level is not very long, You will have to make it to the end of the level without falling. This is because there are NO CHECKPOINTS on your way to the top, making the experience not only slightly longer, but also more challenging to beat | {📅Planned Updates: *Version 1.2+*[Extended Platforming/Parkour + New Secrets + More Music + More Sound Effects], *Version 2.0+*[Extension of Gameplay + Checkpoints/Saves + Endings + Easter Eggs + New Environments + Prototype Title Removal + More], *Version 3.0+*[Extension of Platforms + Levels + New Character(s)]📅} | (This is a Prototype Made by ItsThatDevSimplySamuel)
